blogs.title: Why Language Models Still Stumble After 4K Tokens – The Context Window Problem Explained
blogs.description: A beginner‑friendly overview of what a context window is, why most LLMs are capped at a few thousand tokens, and how this limitation hurts real‑world use cases like long document summarization and multi‑shot prompting. The post sets the stage for why extending context windows matters.

blogs.title: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) 101: The Secret Sauce Behind LLMs’ Position Awareness
blogs.description: Breaks down the mathematics of RoPE in plain language, visualizes how rotary angles encode token order, and shows why naïve scaling of RoPE fails when we add millions of new positions. Includes simple code snippets to illustrate RoPE generation.

blogs.title: From 4K to 2 Million Tokens: How LongRoPE Finds the Sweet Spot with Non‑Uniform Interpolation
blogs.description: Explains the core insight of LongRoPE – treating RoPE dimensions and early token positions differently. Describes the evolutionary search that discovers per‑dimension scaling factors, and why this non‑uniform approach beats linear interpolation, NTK, and YaRN.

blogs.title: Progressive Extension – Fine‑Tuning Only 1K Steps to Reach a 2 048K Context Window
blogs.description: Walks readers through LongRoPE’s three‑stage recipe: (1) search for a 256K RoPE, (2) fine‑tune for just 1 000 steps on modest data, and (3) a second search to jump from 256K to 2 048K. Highlights the efficiency gains and hardware savings compared to brute‑force fine‑tuning.

blogs.title: Does Bigger Always Mean Better? Maintaining Short‑Context Performance After Extreme Extension
blogs.description: Discusses the ‘crowding’ issue that harms LLMs on short prompts after massive positional scaling, and shows how LongRoPE’s extra search step readjusts RoPE for 4K–8K windows. Includes benchmark results that reassure developers their existing apps won’t break.

blogs.title: Real‑World Tests: Passkey Retrieval, Perplexity, and Benchmarks on a 2 Million‑Token Model
blogs.description: Presents the experimental evidence – perplexity on PG19/Proof‑Pile, passkey‑retrieval accuracy up to 2 048K tokens, and standard zero/few‑shot benchmark scores. Translates the numbers into what they mean for developers building long‑form generation tools.

blogs.title: Beyond LongRoPE: Where Do We Go From Here? Future Directions for Ultra‑Long Context LLMs
blogs.description: Speculates on next steps such as combining LongRoPE with retrieval‑augmented or sparse‑attention techniques, scaling to even larger models, and open research challenges like handling billion‑token texts or dynamic context resizing at inference time.
